grants.browserHint: Authorisation code, with a proof key
grants.refreshHint: Stay signed in with a refresh token
grants.deviceHint: Sign in on a device without a browser, such as a command line
grants.exchangeHint: Swap one token for another, for a service acting for a person
grants.cibaHint: Ask the person to approve on their phone (CIBA)

status.pkceExemptTitle: It doesn't have to send a proof key until {{date}}

list.title: Applications
list.description: Apps that sign people in with Qeet ID.

empty.title: No applications yet
empty.description: Register an app to let people sign in to it with Qeet ID.

emptyFiltered.title: No applications match
emptyFiltered.description: Nothing here matches the search or the view.

band.signedInNote: Holding a live sign-in to one of them now

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: Every app using this client ID stops signing people in, and people signed in to it can't renew their sign-in.

drawer.title: Register an application
drawer.description: An app that signs people in with Qeet ID, over OpenID Connect.
drawer.editDescription: Changes apply to the next sign-in.
drawer.madeDescription: Copy its secret before you close this.
drawer.secretDescription: You won't see it again: Qeet ID keeps only a hash. Put it in the app's environment; if it's lost, rotate it.
drawer.name: Name
drawer.nameHint: People see it on the hosted sign-in page.
drawer.typePublic: Runs in a browser or on a device (public)
drawer.typeConfidentialHint: It keeps a client secret, shown once when it's made.
drawer.typePublicHint: It has no secret: it proves each sign-in with a proof key.
drawer.redirectsHint: One a line. Where Qeet ID may send people back after they sign in; localhost is fine while you build.
drawer.afterSignOutHint: One a line. Where people may land after they sign out.
drawer.grantsHint: How the app gets tokens. A public app can't hold the ones that need a secret.
drawer.scopesHint: Separated by spaces. openid, profile and email are the usual ones.

required.name: Enter a name.
required.redirect: Add at least one redirect URI.
required.uri: Enter one full URL a line.
required.clientCredentials: Drop client_credentials: apps can't use it any more. A machine caller is a service principal.

notFound.title: Application not found
notFound.description: No application here has the ID {{clientId}}. It may have been deleted.

test.noRedirectText: There's nowhere to send you back to after signing in.

pkce.exemptTitle: PKCE is off for this app until {{date}}
pkce.exemptText: After that, its sign-ins must send a proof key and a nonce, or they fail. Update {{name}} to send them before then.
pkce.endedText: Its sign-ins now fail unless they send a proof key and a nonce. Update {{name}} to send them.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.note: What the app presents to Qeet ID.
credentials.secretHint: Shown once when it was made. Rotating stops the old one at once.
credentials.confidentialHint: Runs on a server and keeps a client secret.
credentials.publicHint: Has no secret: it sends a proof key with each sign-in.

signIn.title: Sign-in
signIn.note: Where Qeet ID sends people, and what the app may ask for.
signIn.redirectsHint: Test sign-in returns to the first.

security.title: Security
security.pkceRequiredHint: Each sign-in must send a proof key and a nonce, as every app must.
security.pkceExemptHint: Until then, its sign-ins may leave out the proof key and nonce. Every other app must send them.
security.pkceEndedHint: Its exemption has ended, so its sign-ins must send a proof key and a nonce.
security.wrongSecretsHint: Ten wrong secrets in 15 minutes lock the app out for a while (the server's default).

look.title: Sign-in page
look.note: How the app looks on Qeet ID's hosted sign-in page.

rotate.title: Rotate the secret of {{name}}?
rotate.description: The secret {{name}} uses now stops working at once, and its sign-ins fail until it has the new one.
rotate.madeDescription: You won't see it again. Put it in the app's environment; the old one has stopped working.

danger.title: Delete this application
danger.note: Every app using this client ID stops signing people in.

endpoints.title: Endpoints
endpoints.note: Most libraries need only the issuer: they read the rest from discovery.

snippet.title: Add sign-in to the app
snippet.noteConfidential: Filled in with this app's client ID and scopes. The secret comes from an environment variable.
snippet.notePublic: Filled in with this app's client ID and scopes. A public app has no secret.
snippet.testNote: Test sign-in opens this app's sign-in and returns to {{uri}}.
snippet.testNoteNone: Add a redirect URI to test sign-in.

presentation.logoUriHelp: Shown on the hosted sign-in page. An https:// address of up to 2048 characters, without a user name, password or #fragment.
presentation.clientUriHelp: The hosted sign-in page shows its host. An https:// address of up to 2048 characters, without a user name, password or #fragment.

validation.malformed: Enter a full address, such as https://app.example.com.
validation.notHttps: Use an https:// address: http and other schemes aren't accepted.
validation.credentials: Leave out the user name and password.
